title: Motion Verbs 8: Prefix в- (step into) and the ъ spelling
titleRussian: Глаголы движения 8: Приставка в- (войти, въехать) и твёрдый знак
description: The prefix в- attaches to идти / ехать and turns the verb perfective, with the meaning of stepping into a bounded space. Choose вошёл / въехал for crossing a threshold (vs при- for plain arrival), and spell въехал with the hard sign ъ.
descriptionRussian: Приставка в- присоединяется к «идти» и «ехать» и делает глагол совершенного вида со значением входа в замкнутое пространство. Выбирайте «вошёл» / «въехал» для пересечения порога (в отличие от «при-» для простого приезда) и пишите «въехал» с твёрдым знаком.
intro: The last prefix is the mirror of the one before: crossing a threshold inwards. It also brings the only spelling rule in this book. When this prefix meets a root beginning with a vowel, Russian inserts a hard sign to keep them apart, which is one of the very few jobs that letter still does in the modern language.
rules: Войти = perfective of идти; въехать = perfective of ехать. Both mark the moment of entering a specific bounded space (room, building, vehicle, city). Past forms are the focus: вошёл / вошла / вошли (irregular), въехал / въехала / въехали (regular).
В- vs при-: при- reports a plain arrival (trip done); в- adds the threshold focus, the moment the subject crossed the door, often with an action right after inside the space.
Reach for в- when 'walked into / stepped into' fits, when a sequence happens inside («вошёл и сел»), or when a phrase names the entry point («через ворота», «через дверь»).

Spelling: въехать takes the hard sign ъ because the prefix в- ends in a consonant and the root е-хать begins with е. The same rule gives объехал, съехал, подъезд. It is always ъ between prefix and root, never ь.
The destination preposition в + acc pairs naturally with the prefix в- (вошёл в комнату, въехал в город). The prefix changes the verb, not the case the preposition governs.
examples: Антон тихо вошёл в комнату и закрыл за собой дверь. (Anton quietly entered the room and closed the door behind him.) Adverb of careful entry + sequence inside the space.
Маша вошла в офис в девять часов и сразу поздоровалась со всеми. (Masha entered the office at nine and immediately greeted everyone.) Sequence inside the space.
Машина въехала во двор через ворота. (The car drove into the courtyard through the gate.) Note the ъ in въехала; 'через + acc' names the threshold.
Иван въехал в город по новому мосту. (Ivan drove into the city across the new bridge.) Spelling: въехал with ъ; в + acc names the bounded city space.
Дети вошли в класс и сели на свои места. (The kids walked into the classroom and took their seats.) Plural threshold + immediate action.
Соня вошла в автобус и села у окна. (Sonya got onto the bus and sat by the window.) Vehicle as a small bounded space + sequence inside.

tables.title: В- vs при-: which prefix wins

rows.label: sequence inside the space (и закрыл дверь, и поздоровалась)
из + gen source phrase (из Москвы, из школы)
через + acc threshold phrase (через ворота, через мост)
cells: The entry point itself is named

rows.label: event destination на + acc (на встречу, на лекцию)
cells: Events take при-, not в-, by convention

rows.label: careful or quiet entry adverb (тихо, осторожно)

rows.label: specific small bounded destination (в комнату, в машину)

items.promptEnglish: Masha got out of the car in front of the house.
items.hint: Recap from Lesson 7: a vehicle is a small bounded space. Which prefix marks the moment of exit?
items.explanation: Recap from Lesson 7: машина is a small bounded space, and the standard form for exiting a vehicle is выйти. Fem past → вышла. Шла would describe motion in progress, пошла marks setting off, ушла marks leaving away. Today's lesson introduces the mirror prefix в- for entering a bounded space.

items.prompt: Антон тихо _____ в комнату, чтобы не разбудить ребёнка.
items.promptEnglish: Anton quietly entered the room so as not to wake the child.
items.hint: 'Тихо' marks a careful threshold-crossing. Which prefix matches the moment of stepping in?
items.explanation: 'Тихо' is a careful-entry adverb that highlights the act of crossing the doorway: the threshold is the marked event. Masc past of войти → вошёл. Пришёл would frame the trip as done without focusing on the threshold; пошёл would mark the moment of setting off; шёл would describe motion in progress. Only вошёл captures the threshold reading.

items.prompt: Иван _____ в город по новому мосту.
items.promptEnglish: Ivan drove into the city across the new bridge.
items.hint: 'По новому мосту' names the entry point of the city. Which transport prefix matches? Note the spelling.
items.explanation: 'По мосту' names a specific entry point for a city: vehicles enter Russian cities across bridges, gates, and ring roads. Threshold + transport → въехал (note the ъ between the consonant prefix в- and the root е-хать). Приехал would frame the arrival without the threshold focus; поехал would mark setting off; ехал would describe him in transit at some point.

items.prompt: Маша _____ в офис в девять часов и сразу поздоровалась со всеми.
items.promptEnglish: Masha walked into the office at nine and immediately greeted everyone.
items.hint: The sequence inside the office (поздоровалась) starts at the moment she crosses the door. Which prefix?
items.explanation: 'И сразу поздоровалась' is a sequence-inside-the-space cue: the greeting is the immediate consequence of crossing the threshold. Fem past of войти → вошла. Шла would describe motion in progress; пошла would mark setting off; пришла would report plain arrival without the threshold + immediate-action structure that в- captures.

items.prompt: Дети _____ в класс и сели на свои места.
items.promptEnglish: The kids walked into the classroom and took their seats.
items.hint: The sequence (сели на свои места) starts at the moment they cross the classroom door. Plural threshold?
items.explanation: The 'сели на свои места' clause is the immediate next event after the kids cross the door: classic threshold + sequence-inside framing. Plural past of войти → вошли. Пришли would frame the trip as done without focusing on the threshold; шли would describe motion in progress; пошли would mark setting off elsewhere.

items.prompt: Машина _____ во двор и остановилась у подъезда.
items.promptEnglish: The car drove into the courtyard and stopped by the entrance.
items.hint: Двор is a bounded space; the next event is inside. Which transport prefix? Spelling note.
items.explanation: 'Во двор и остановилась' is the threshold-plus-sequence pattern on transport: the stopping happens inside the courtyard immediately after the car crosses its boundary. Fem past of въехать → въехала (with ъ). The preposition is во for euphony before two consonants (вд-вор). Приехала would frame the arrival without the threshold focus; поехала would mark setting off; ехала would describe her on the road at some past moment.

items.prompt: Антон тихо _____ и сел за стол.
items.promptEnglish: Anton quietly entered the room and sat down at the table.
items.hint: Crossing the doorway into a bounded space, masculine.
items.explanation: Entering a bounded space takes в-: вошёл в комнату. Пришёл frames the whole journey's endpoint; the 'и сел' sequence hangs on the threshold moment, which в- captures.

items.promptEnglish: Lena got on the bus and took a window seat.
items.explanation: Boarding a vehicle is entering a bounded space: вошла в автобус. Пришла would end a journey; ехала is mid-ride; the sitting follows the threshold crossing.

items.promptEnglish: The car drove into the courtyard through the gate.
items.hint: Entering by transport: mind the hard sign.
items.explanation: Entering a bounded space by vehicle takes въ- (with the hard sign): въехала во двор. Приехала marks the trip's end, not the gate-crossing; the 'через ворота' cue names the threshold.

items.promptEnglish: The guests drove into the city across the new bridge.
items.explanation: Crossing into the city takes въехали (hard sign between prefix and root). Приехали из города would be arriving FROM it; поехали marks setting off; ездили is a round trip.

blanks: Маша _____ в магазин и сразу подошла к продавцу. (Masha walked into the store and immediately went up to the clerk.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: 'Сразу подошла к продавцу' is a sequence-inside-the-space cue: the next action follows immediately upon the threshold crossing. Fem past of войти → вошла. Пришла would frame the trip as done at the store level without the threshold focus; пошла would mark setting off elsewhere; шла would describe motion in progress.

sentenceBuilding.answer: Антон вошёл в офис и поздоровался.
sentenceBuilding.translation: Anton entered the office and said hello.
acceptableVariants: Антон вошёл в офис и поздоровался

sentenceBuilding.answer: Машина въехала во двор через ворота.
sentenceBuilding.translation: The car drove into the courtyard through the gate.
acceptableVariants: Машина въехала во двор через ворота

sentenceBuilding.answer: Дети вошли в класс и сели.
sentenceBuilding.translation: The kids walked into the classroom and sat down.
acceptableVariants: Дети вошли в класс и сели

errorCorrection.sentence: Антон пришёл в комнату и сразу сел за стол.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Anton walked into the room and immediately sat down at the table.
errorCorrection.explanation: A room is a small bounded space, and 'и сразу сел за стол' is a sequence-inside cue: the sitting follows immediately upon crossing the doorway. The threshold reading selects войти: вошёл. Пришёл frames a trip as done at a destination (better for 'пришёл домой', 'пришёл на работу'), not the act of stepping through a doorway into a room. Пошёл marks setting off; шёл motion in progress.

errorCorrection.sentence: Машины приехали во двор через ворота и остановились у подъезда.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: The cars drove into the courtyard through the gate and stopped by the entrance.
errorCorrection.explanation: 'Через ворота' explicitly names the entry point, and двор is the bounded space being entered, so the threshold reading selects въехать: въехали (note the hard sign ъ between the consonant prefix в- and the root).

errorCorrection.sentence: Иван вьехал в город по новому мосту.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Ivan drove into the city across the new bridge.
errorCorrection.explanation: Въехать is written with the hard sign ъ between the consonant-final prefix в- and the root е-хать: въехал. The soft sign (вьехал) is wrong here; ъ, not ь, separates a prefix from a root in е, ё, ю, я. Вехал (no separator) and виехал (inserting и) are also wrong: the rule calls specifically for a hard sign. The same pattern gives объехал, съехал, подъезд.

minimalPairs.context: Антон _____ в комнату и сразу подошёл к окну.
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Anton walked into the room and immediately went up to the window.
minimalPairs.explanation: 'И сразу подошёл к окну' is the threshold + immediate-action pattern: the next event happens inside the room as a direct consequence of the entry. В- captures that focus; пришёл would frame the trip as done at the room level, neutral on the immediate next event.

minimalPairs.context: Машина _____ во двор через ворота и медленно поехала к подъезду.
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: The car drove into the courtyard through the gate and slowly moved toward the entrance.
minimalPairs.explanation: 'Через ворота' explicitly names the entry point; 'медленно поехала к подъезду' is a sequence inside the courtyard. Both cues point to в-: въехала. Приехала would frame the courtyard as the trip's endpoint, but the next clause shows motion continuing inside the space, which the threshold reading hosts more cleanly.

reviewVocab.definition: Perfective verbs formed with в- + идти / ехать. They mark the moment the subject crossed a specific threshold and entered a bounded space (room, building, vehicle, city). Past forms вошёл / въехал are the workhorses at this stage. Note the ъ in въехал.
reviewVocab.example: Антон вошёл в комнату и закрыл дверь.

reviewVocab.definition: The 'step-in' prefix in the motion-verb system, the mirror of вы-. Attached to идти / ехать it makes perfective verbs of crossing an entry threshold. It overlaps with при- (Lesson 5) but adds a threshold focus and pairs with sequences inside the space.
reviewVocab.example: Машина въехала во двор через ворота.

reviewVocab.definition: The hard sign written between a consonant-final prefix (в, об, с, под) and a root that begins with е, ё, ю, or я. Examples: въехать, объехать, съехать, подъезд. It marks a clear break so the prefix consonant does not soften the root vowel.
reviewVocab.example: Иван въехал в город. (Note: ъ separates в- from е-хать.)
